## [v27](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-handynotes-directions/tree/v27) (2026-10-10)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-handynotes-directions/compare/v26...v27) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/kemayo/wow-handynotes-directions/releases)

- TOC for 12.1.0, 2.5.6, 1.15.9, Forever  
- Actions: drop the submodules flag from a repo with no submodules  
    This repo has no submodules, so submodules: recursive was a no-op. Updates  
    the checkout action from v2 to v7, which was still running a node version  
    GitHub is retiring; nothing in that range affects a push-triggered  
    workflow. Pins the packager to v2 rather than master, so an upstream change  
    can no longer land in a release without warning; v2 is the maintained major  
    tag, so fixes within the v2 line still arrive.
